notes.title: Free unofficial open world Superman game Undefeated gets a PC update with heat vision alongside a surprise PS5 launch
notes.content: Sometimes we play video games to plunder the silty depths of our emotions, sometimes we play them to sharpen our wits and try the alchemy of engrossing systems, sometimes we play them to mud-wrestle with questions of power and responsibility, and sometimes we just want to wear cool sunglasses, have big arms, and fly around hitting stuff very hard. notes.title: UNDEFEATED and UNDEFEATED: Genesis are coming to PS5!
notes.content:
Dear Hero fans who have been playing 'UNDEFEATED',

Hi! This is the "UNDEFEATED" dev team.
Thank you for your continued support of 'UNDEFEATED'. It truly means a lot to all of us.

We are very excited to be able to make this announcement to you today.
Our game 'UNDEFEATED' which has been downloaded over 2 million times worldwide will be released not only on PC (Steam) but also on PlayStation 5.
In addition, it has also been decided that the latest title currently under development, 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis', will also be released on PS5.
Both games will be released by Chorus Worldwide, the publisher of the Steam version 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis'.

[previewyoutube=g3rkF0VPWKQ;full][/previewyoutube]

The PS5 version of UNDEFEATED includes 4K support and the latest updates that will be released for the PC (Steam) version, and you can play it for FREE.
Experience the invincible superhero not only on PC (Steam), but also on PS5!

PlayStation Store

 UNDEFEATED (Free): https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011751
 UNDEFEATED: Genesis (Scheduled to launch in 2026): https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011831
Don't forget to add to your wishlist! 

About UNDEFEATED
'UNDEFEATED' was originally a student project from Vantan Game Academy in Japan that was released for free on Steam in August 2019. As of September 2024, it has been downloaded over 2 million times worldwide.
The aim of the game was to make players feel like a real superhero, flying freely around a city and wielding awesome powers to save the inhabitants with a simple and intuitive control method.
'UNDEFEATED' has received high praise from many superhero fans and gamers, especially from international players.

After graduating from Vantan Game Academy, the development team gained experience in the gaming industry and then reunited at Indie-us Games in Osaka, Japan, where they are currently working on 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis,' the latest installment in the UNDEFEATED series, with a planned release in 2026.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1116960/UNDEFEATED/

What's 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis'?
'UNDEFEATED: Genesis' is a superhero action game set on a massive alien planet.
Developed in Unreal Engine 5, the game builds on 'UNDEFEATED' and the feeling of being a superhero, but is vastly scaled up in scope, technology, and story. In 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis', players will experience flying across a huge environment, developing and using astounding superpowers, and experiencing a rich storyline.
The game is being developed with the intention of delivering a true "superhero experience" to fans and aims to make players feel the same sense of power as heroes in comics and manga.

'UNDEFEATED: Genesis' takes place in the same universe as 'UNDEFEATED' and narratively serves as its prequel.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/

notes.title: New super power is now available - Super Power Update!
notes.content:
Hi! This is the "UNDEFEATED" dev team.
Thank you for your continued support of "UNDEFEATED”. It truly means a lot to all of us.

We have added the long-awaited super power to celebrate the release of the PS5 version and 2 million downloads.

[previewyoutube=VOIrhnkLUaU;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes
New Super Power

Added new super powers unlocked when hero rank is B or higher.
If you have already met the conditions, you can use it.
New Events

Added new events that occur when the hero rank is B or higher.
You can transform the newly added superpower into “the long-awaited superpower”.
Gameplay Changes

Supports 4K resolution (3840x2160) and WQHD resolution (2560x1440)
Some billboards have been redesigned.
The billboards were redesigned during the last major update, and they continue to appear in this update as well. Please try to find them.
[hr][/hr]
This year marks the fifth year since UNDEFEATED's release.
UNDEFEATED has also started to be released on PS5 today, and the PC (Steam) version has finally surpassed 2 million downloads. We had no idea that our student project would have such a big impact.
We would like to send our thanks to everyone once again.

Thank you for your continued support of 'UNDEFEATED'.

This update is our way of saying thank you to all of our users who have always supported us.
Please enjoy the new super powers.

For more information about the PS5 version of UNDEFEATED, which was released today, and the decision to release the PS5 version of UNDEFEATED: Genesis, please read this article.

https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2088020/view/4580811814120724098

We will continue to work hard on development with the aim of releasing 'UNDEFEATED: Genesis' in 2026.
Please check out the store page and add it to your wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/

[hr][/hr]
Our goal continues to be to make the most exciting hero experience possible and that will continue in UNDEFEATED: Genesis!

From all of us on the UNDEFEATED team, thank you all for your continued support of 'UNDEFEATED'.

notes.title: Major Update Available!
notes.content:
Hi! This is the "UNDEFEATED" dev team.
Thank you for your continued support of "UNDEFEATED”. It truly means a lot to all of us.

We are excited to let everyone know that we have fixed the major issue which led to the game crashing for many players.
We have also made other small fixes and changes so please check them out.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35464748/461d5a7008fe047ffd8918256a77de71d9e07b6b.png

[hr][/hr]
Patch Notes
Crash Bugs

Fixed an issue that caused the game to crash on startup.
Fixed an issue where the game would crash after a certain amount of time from the start of the game.
We have done our best to fix these issues. However, these fixes may still not make the game playable for everyone, but we believe it is now playable for more people than ever before. Thank you for your patience and understanding.
Language support

The language setting is now set to "English" when the game is launched for the first time.
The display may sometimes still show a mixture of Japanese and English. If you encounter this issue, please try changing language and back again.
Gameplay Changes

Fixed a bug where the normal number of gangs was not generated and quests did not progress.
Increased the amount of damage dealt to bosses based on the player’s hero rank.
Fixed a problem where citizens would remain in a "running away" state.
Some billboards have been redesigned.

Easter Eggs

We have added a very small number of Easter Eggs…

[hr][/hr]
Finally, thank you for supporting UNDEFEATED for the past four years.
We are now working hard to release UNDEFEATED: Genesis in 2026.

Please check out our store page and add it to your wishlist. It helps us a huge amount!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/

[hr][/hr]
Our goal continues to be to make the most exciting hero experience possible and that will continue in UNDEFEATED: Genesis!

From all of us on the UNDEFEATED team, thank you all for your continued support of "UNDEFEATED".

notes.content:

Thank you for your continued support of "UNDEFEATED”.

We first released this game four years ago in August 2019. Since then, there have been over 1.95m downloads! We never expected so many people to play our free student project and we’re extremely grateful to everyone that has.

notes.title: Sequel "UNDEFEATED: Genesis" announced!
notes.content:
Dear Hero fans who have been playing "UNDEFEATED",

It has been almost 4 years since we released this game.
We are very grateful that so many of you have played our game.
With more than 1.8 million downloads to date, the game has enthralled many Hero fans, but the lack of word on what has happened since then may have left some of you feeling a little anxious.

We are pleased to announce "UNDEFEATED: Genesis", the latest installment in the UNDEFEATED series for fans of UNDEFEATED, to answer your expectations.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35464748/34abd1b6e92f857e3cd6994870e494cb145abbe0.png

UNDEFEATED: Genesis.
The superhero action game that has been in development under the name "UNRESTRICTED" has now been reborn as "UNDEFEATED: Genesis".
"UNDEFEATED: Genesis" is the sequel to "UNDEFEATED." In order to bring this game to "UNDEFEATED" fans, we have changed the title to a name that is a continuation of "UNDEFEATED.

"UNDEFEATED: Genesis" is the first in a trilogy of games in the UNDEFEATED series.
We begin our story with ‘Genesis’... 

Partnering with Publishers.
We have decided to partner with the publisher "Chorus Worldwide" on UNDEFEATED: Genesis".
We hope you will look forward to a great Hero experience created by the collaboration between our Hero game and Corus Worldwide, which has produced many Narrative games.
We will be showcasing our games at this year's Tokyo Game Show in September, so if you're going to be there, please visit the Corus Worldwide booth and experience our games for yourself.

Here is the latest trailer we have just released. Please check it out.
[previewyoutube=BKjkS9JyIwY;full][/previewyoutube]

[hr][/hr]
We have learned a lot since we released "Undefeated" back in our student days.
We can't wait for you guys to play UNDEFEATED: Genesis, which we developed with the new skills we gained.

Please support us by adding "UNDEFEATED: Genesis" to your wish list!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2088020/UNDEFEATED_Genesis/
